in_marathi.name: Rupjyoti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Light of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rupjyoti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rupjyoti is a Sanskrit and Bengali name meaning 'Light of Wealth'. This name is derived from the words 'rup' meaning wealth and 'jyoti' meaning light. It represents the radiance and prosperity that comes with financial abundance.
